spans.s:
The affix आम् is optionally used after these - उष् 'to burn', विद् 'to know' and जागृ 'to wake', when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows.

Terms: आम्

The affix र comes after the words 1. ऊष 2. सुषि 3. मुष्क and 4. मधु with the force of मतुप्।

Terms: र

For उषस् is substituted उषासा in a देवता - द्वन्द समास।

Terms: विभक्ति-Non-elision
